assumptions.statement: Project-level regulatory-plan conditions, road redlines, rail and station engineering conditions, parcel and ownership records, existing-building and retain-renovate-remove evidence, municipal utilities, energy, drainage and flood control, fire safety, heritage protection, ecological control and public-service facility data are not provided in the organizer package; they must be confirmed from official attachments before any statutory or engineering use.
assumptions.impact: The package is a concept proposal based on submitted provisional geometry. It cannot establish official boundaries, statutory controls, approvals, demolition/retention decisions, engineering quantities, or implementation commitments.

assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and all three KEY_AREA features in this package are provisional constraints sourced from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.impact: All area, ratio, distance, phasing and spatial-relationship values are temporary design-audit calculations and must be recalculated when organizer-supplied official polygons are available.

assumptions.statement: The proposal adapts the public-service ideas of proactive, fair, professional and individualized service as a design method only. It does not claim endorsement, partnership, licensing, or operational involvement by Pangdonglai.
assumptions.impact: Every AI service concept must provide an offline or human-assisted alternative, clear notice, minimum necessary data, accountable human review, and an opt-out or safe fallback path.

assumptions.statement: References to Beiwai community, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area and the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region are proposed collaboration interfaces, not confirmed partnerships or institutional arrangements.
assumptions.impact: Future factual descriptions require approved formal sources and confirmation by relevant organizations.

assumptions.statement: Verifiable demand and operations baselines for industry, talent, slow mobility, facilities and services are not yet established: the AI innovation index, talent density, 15-minute accessibility, event participation and similar performance metrics currently have no verified method, sample, baseline year or confidence level.
assumptions.impact: All such metrics are declared unknown/待校准 and must not be presented as measured facts. The proposal only supplies proposed definitions and calibration paths (public statistical sources, scenario-operation logs, resident-feedback loops); a baseline year, sample and method will be fixed together with professional teams after operations begin.
